data.name: Bloodsoaked Ruins
data.passiveDescription: For 3.5s after using an Elemental Burst, the equipping character’s Lunar-Charged DMG dealt to opponents is increased by {{36//48//60//72//84%}}. Additionally, after triggering a Lunar-Charged reaction, the equipping character will gain Requiem of Ruin: CRIT DMG is increased by {{28//35//42//49//56%}} for 6s. They will also regain {{12//13//14//15//16}} Elemental Energy. Elemental Energy can be restored this way once every 14s.
